name: Stay Close To Your Parents
overview: Scripture calls believers to honor and obey their parents as a fundamental duty that brings blessing and longevity, as seen in Exodus 20:12 and Ephesians 6:1. Children are described as a heritage from the Lord (Psalms 127:3), emphasizing the sacredness of family relationships. Parents are instructed to lovingly train and correct their children in the ways of the Lord, fostering spiritual growth without provoking anger (Proverbs 22:6; Proverbs 29:17; Ephesians 6:4). Together, these verses highlight the importance of maintaining close, respectful, and God-centered family bonds.
